thread.title: Will the market help or harm the Republicans for the midterm elections?

author: Luckyone
title: Will the market help or harm the Republicans for the midterm elections?
text: 1,431 Will the market help or harm the Republicans for the midterm elections? As I stated several times before, I am a stock market chart analyst and I make my living giving stock market mentions. The first 3 weeks of any earnings quarter have belonged to the bulls for the past few years. This has happened more so in the Tech Industry than in any other and the stocks that have generally been the leaders (NFLX, AMZN, GOOGL, FB and AAPL) are the ones who generally come in much better than anticipated and have generated the strong moves up in the market that have been seen, each and every quarter. Exactly 3 weeks ago, prior to the beginning of the earnings quarter, the indexes took a strong fall with the NASDAQ falling 10.3% from 8107 to 7270 but the index started to recover 7 trading days ago given the earnings quarter was to begin (traders anticipating good news). On Tuesday of last week the first of the "big 5" tech stocks reported earnings (NFLX) and the earnings report came in much higher than anticipated and the stock opened 9% higher, having closed the afternoon before the report came out at 346.40 and the morning after getting up as high as 380.00. Lo and behold the bulls were back in business, or so it was thought, but by Friday, the stock had fallen and the stock closed at 332.67, which is 2% lower than before the report came out. That is an 11% shift from high to low in 3 days. Needless to say, the NASDAQ also closed lower on Friday and this has to be considered a disappointing start to the earnings quarter. Two more of the big 5 reports come out this week on Thursday after the close with AMZN and GOOGL reporting and if the same fate occurs to them as with NFLX, the traders will see it as a sign that things are turning bad (likely due to the Trade War, or so the analysts say) and that would be a sign to sell, sell, and sell some more. If this occurs this week and the week after when AAPL and FB report, it will look bad for the Republicans going into the midterm elections given that the Trade War is and would be blamed for the big fall in the indexes. I am giving you this information so you can follow it yourself. This is not an "opinion" piece, it is reporting what is "actually" happening to the market and what will likely happen if the same thing that happened this week with NFLX happens next week with AMZN and GOOGL. Eyes wide open guys, especially if you are invested in the market. By the way and for your information. Both the SPX and NASDAQ gave chart failure signals 2 weeks ago and those failure signals were confirmed this week, meaning that the traders are actually "anticipating" negative action. My guiding principles in life are to be honest, genuine, thoughtful and caring. Money is important but secondary. Re: Will the market help or harm the Republicans for the midterm elections?
